# opencode-glm-quota

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

An [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) CLI plugin that shows your **GLM Coding Plan quota** in the terminal status bar — the same badge ported from the DSH plugin `dsh-web-enhance`.

![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@yangzhe1991/opencode-glm-quota) ![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@yangzhe1991/opencode-glm-quota)

## What it shows

- **Status bar badge** (right side, next to the health indicators): `5h额度4%，周额度17%，周窗口10%` — 5-hour window usage, weekly usage, and weekly time progress (usage ahead of time progress = burning quota faster than the week elapses)
- **Details dialog** via the `/quota` slash command (or command palette → “GLM Coding Plan quota”):

```
GLM Coding Plan（max） · 用量为账号级真实数据
5 小时窗口 2%（距重置 4小时31分）
本周 16%，本窗口已过 10%，距离重置 6天6小时
更新于 18:33:42
```

Usage numbers are **account-level real data** from Zhipu's official quota API (`/api/monitor/usage/quota/limit`) — consumption from Claude Code and other tools on the same plan is included. No local token-based estimation.

## Install

```sh
opencode plugin add @yangzhe1991/opencode-glm-quota
```

Or add it to `~/.config/opencode/cli.json` (CLI-only plugin, also active against remote servers):

```json
{
  "plugins": ["@yangzhe1991/opencode-glm-quota"]
}
```

## API key resolution

The plugin looks for a key in this order and uses the first one that works:

1. Plugin options: `{ "package": "@yangzhe1991/opencode-glm-quota", "options": { "apiKey": "…", "endpoint": "https://open.bigmodel.cn" } }`
2. Environment variables: `ZAI_CODING_CN_API_KEY` (→ `open.bigmodel.cn`) or `ZAI_API_KEY` (→ `api.z.ai`)
3. The connected OpenCode server's provider config — any provider whose `baseURL` is on `bigmodel.cn` / `z.ai` with an `apiKey` (e.g. the built-in `zhipuai-coding-plan` provider). If you already use the GLM Coding Plan as your OpenCode provider, **zero extra configuration is needed**.

## Refresh cadence

Fetches on startup, after each finished session response (throttled to at most once per minute), and every 5 minutes as a fallback. Failed fetches keep the last payload and surface the error in the `/quota` dialog.

## Local development

```sh
git clone https://github.com/yangzhe1991/opencode-glm-quota
# point cli.json at the checkout:
#   "plugins": ["/absolute/path/to/opencode-glm-quota"]
npm install && npm run typecheck
bun probe/quota-probe.mts   # validates the fetch → normalize → badge pipeline with real credentials
```

Changes under watched config directories reload automatically; otherwise restart the TUI.

## Compatibility

Verified against **opencode v2.0.28** since **0.1.0**.

# opencode-glm-quota

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

一个 [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) CLI 插件:在终端状态栏显示 **GLM Coding Plan 套餐额度** —— 从 DSH 插件 `dsh-web-enhance` 移植的同款徽章。

![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@yangzhe1991/opencode-glm-quota) ![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@yangzhe1991/opencode-glm-quota)

## 显示内容

- **状态栏徽章**(右侧,健康指示旁边):`5h额度4%，周额度17%，周窗口10%` —— 5 小时窗口用量、周用量、周时间进度(额度进度跑得比时间快 = 消耗超前)
- **明细对话框**:斜杠命令 `/quota`(或命令面板搜 “GLM Coding Plan quota”):

```
GLM Coding Plan（max） · 用量为账号级真实数据
5 小时窗口 2%（距重置 4小时31分）
本周 16%，本窗口已过 10%，距离重置 6天6小时
更新于 18:33:42
```

用量为智谱官方额度 API(`/api/monitor/usage/quota/limit`)返回的**账号级真实数据** —— 同一套餐下 Claude Code 等其它工具的消耗也统计在内,不做本地按 token 的积分估算。

## 安装

```sh
opencode plugin add @yangzhe1991/opencode-glm-quota
```

或写进 `~/.config/opencode/cli.json`(CLI-only 插件,连远程 server 时也生效):

```json
{
  "plugins": ["@yangzhe1991/opencode-glm-quota"]
}
```

## API key 解析链

按以下顺序找 key,第一个可用者胜出:

1. 插件 options:`{ "package": "@yangzhe1991/opencode-glm-quota", "options": { "apiKey": "…", "endpoint": "https://open.bigmodel.cn" } }`
2. 环境变量:`ZAI_CODING_CN_API_KEY`(→ `open.bigmodel.cn`)或 `ZAI_API_KEY`(→ `api.z.ai`)
3. 连接中的 OpenCode server 的 provider 配置 —— 任何 `baseURL` 落在 `bigmodel.cn` / `z.ai` 且配了 `apiKey` 的 provider(如内置的 `zhipuai-coding-plan`)。已经在 OpenCode 里用 GLM Coding Plan 的,**零额外配置**。

## 刷新节奏

启动拉一次;每个会话响应结束后补拉(节流:至多 1 分钟一次);另每 5 分钟兜底一次。拉取失败时保留旧载荷(徽章不闪没),错误经 `/quota` 对话框可见。

## 本地开发

```sh
git clone https://github.com/yangzhe1991/opencode-glm-quota
# cli.json 指向本地检出目录:
#   "plugins": ["/absolute/path/to/opencode-glm-quota"]
npm install && npm run typecheck
bun probe/quota-probe.mts   # 用真实凭据验证 fetch → 归一化 → 徽章 整条链路
```

被监听配置目录下的改动会自动热加载;否则重启 TUI。

## 兼容性

自 **0.1.0** 起在 **opencode v2.0.28** 上验证通过。
